description: Source code for the CryptoAsync class implementing asynchronous cryptographic operations in Android's media framework, including decrypting and handling encrypted buffers.

classes.name: CryptoAsync
classes.description: Class handling asynchronous cryptographic operations, including decrypting buffers and managing encrypted buffer attachments.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Initiates decryption of a message if callback is set and state is active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing operations and clears pending buffers, returning remaining buffers.

methods.name: decryptAndQueue
methods.description: Performs decryption and queues the buffer for processing.

methods.name: attachEncryptedBufferAndQueue
methods.description: Attaches an encrypted buffer and queues it for processing.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages to perform decrypt, attach, or stop actions.
